title: Tesla reportedly flew scalar-powered vehicles

tellings.quote: >> I think he actually I think he actually flew some rumor has it.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla may have actually flown vehicles powered by what fringe researchers call scalar energy, a kind of energy field that mainstream physics does not recognise. The claim comes from Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be implanted in people's bodies, who passes it on as a rumour ("I think he actually flew, rumor has it") and links it to a source called Lost Silence. If true, it would mean Tesla built working craft on a power source science does not accept.
